description: Set a gate to passed only after its evidence has been verified for this release. Do not include credentials.

gates.evidence: 2026-10-10 backend suite: BookingRetriesTest 12 passed, BookingWorkflowTest 24 passed, ConcurrentTwoCustomerBookingTest 2 passed (38 tests covering failed, pending and concurrent retries; replay logged per retried request). Frontend e2e readiness.spec.js 'booking replays an uncertain result with the same key after a reload' passes on Chromium. Note: this evidence covers the replay contract against the local backend; no live Stripe retry was exercised against Stripe itself. The expired-key defect that previously prevented this was rotated and verified on 2026-10-11 (see providerWorkflows), so a live retry is now possible but has not been run.
gates.requirement: Backend replays committed bookings correctly and handles failed, pending and concurrent retries.

gates.evidence: Owner-reported backend suite: 727 passed, fresh database V1-V23 each run; production-copy upgrade tested October 10, 2026. Independently re-verified over SSH on the production VPS on 2026-10-10: flyway_schema_history top row version=23 success=1 (22 and 21 also success=1); SPRING_JPA_HIBERNATE_DDL_AUTO=validate; rapidstylers-api container Up and healthy. Hibernate starting with validate is itself proof the live schema matches the code.
gates.requirement: Fresh and existing database migrations pass; production schema validation is verified.

Frontend: updatePersonalInformation, updateBusinessInformation and updateCoverPhoto are routed under /styler-dashboard inside StylerLayout; 14 tests pass, covering prefill, phone cleaning, email read-only, address requirement, upload-authorization failure, inline save/load errors, and the account-timezone field carried on the business payload. Backend contract: StylerProfileServiceTest 10 passed, StylerProfileStandingTest 4 passed against /styler/profile, /styler/update_personal_info, /styler/update_business_info and /styler/update_photos.
gates.requirement: Authenticated profile-save and account-timezone contracts are implemented and tested, or an approved support-only release scope is recorded.

gates.blocker: Unblocked 2026-10-11 05:53 UTC. The expired sk_test key found on 2026-10-10 (PaymentReconciliationService logged 'Expired API Key provided ... code: api_key_expired' on every scheduled run) was rotated and the API container recreated with docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --force-recreate app. Verified by production audit row id=87 at 2026-10-11 05:53:48, 'Checked 0 Stripe intents; 0 issue(s)': audit() is only reached after fetchRecentIntents() returns, so the row proves the Stripe call authenticated. Container healthy, Flyway 23 validated, zero reconciliation failures since boot. STRIPE_PAYMENT LEGS NOW VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-11, using the production container's own rotated key against Stripe's TEST API via StripeLifecycleTest (the exact StripeService methods the backend calls): create customer -> SetupIntent -> attach pm_card_visa (read back 4242/visa) -> Express Connect account + onboarding link -> authorize 15000 cad hold (requires_capture) -> capture (succeeded) -> authorize 9000 cad -> release (canceled, never charged). 3 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. Webhooks verified live too: Stripe delivered payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.canceled to https://api.rapidstylers.ca/rapid_stylers/stripe/webhook and the backend signature-verified and processed them, logging 'Stripe webhook no-match: ... no booking for payment intent' (correct: the e2e intents have no local appointment). NEW DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED, NOT YET DEPLOYED: PaymentReconciliationService.fetchRecentIntents() built its lookback with a bare .setCreated(sinceEpoch), which Stripe treats as an EXACT-second match, not a lower bound, so every scheduled run fetched 0 intents and reported '0 issue(s)' while examining nothing. The earlier claim that 'Checked 0 Stripe intents' was expected because the account had no intents in the window is disproven: the account has 52 intents inside 72h, all created before the fix. Fixed to created[gte] with a regression test asserting the range shape; verified live: old params 0 intents, new params 52. Payment package 1218 tests, 0 failures. The fix is LOCAL ONLY - the running VPS container still has the buggy filter until the backend image is rebuilt and redeployed. What remains for this gate: deploy that fix, then refunds, disputes, cancellation through the app, ownership denials, and the dev CI secret scan. OTP and signed-upload legs were verified locally on 2026-10-10 (stylist sign-up used the signup upload pass; upload intercepted before any network egress).
gates.requirement: OTP, signed uploads, Stripe test payments/webhooks/cancellation/refunds and ownership denials pass; dev CI including secret scan passes for the candidate.

gates.blocker: Partial only, verified 2026-10-10. Chromium: full e2e suite 20/20 passed. WebKit 27.2: 13/17 passed; the 7 failures (admin-registration x4, readiness x3) all share one signature, 'page.goto ... interrupted by another navigation', a redirect race rather than an assertion failure, and a standalone WebKit script completed the full 5-step stylist sign-up flow including photo restore. Firefox: NOT VERIFIED - Playwright's Firefox cannot launch on this machine ('Could not find profile folder'), an environment fault reproducible from a minimal launch, not an app fault. Section 3 still requires real Safari and Firefox on the live site, plus iPhone, before this can be signed off.
gates.requirement: Supported Safari and Firefox flows are verified in addition to Chromium.
